purpose: Source-backed engineering trajectory and error-direction examples for the completed fire-family holdouts
prerequisite: All ten LOCO protocols have 35 completed runs, completed independent predictive replay, complete paired engineering statistics and independent arithmetic reviews. No partial-family prediction scores may be read to make this figure.
population: Exactly 997 unique cases, each appearing once in its own fire-family test set. IID and crack-count test predictions are excluded.
case_selection_score: For each case, the arithmetic mean over five seeds of the mean absolute error over all 61 times, using the sum-message GNN only.
quantile_rule: Select the score at zero-based rank floor((997-1)*fraction). For equal scores, choose the lexicographically smallest sample_id at that score, excluding an already selected case when available.
fourth_example: Among cases not already selected, maximize the sum-message GNN score mean_over_seeds(max_over_61_times(max(prediction-reference, 0))). Break exact ties by lexicographically smallest sample_id. Label this example Largest remaining mean positive peak. If every remaining score is zero, retain the deterministic selection and explicitly state that no remaining positive-error case exists; do not describe it as an overprediction failure.
selection_scope: All four cases are selected using GNN errors, so median and tail labels refer only to that model's five-seed mean case-error distribution. The matched-DeepSets curves provide paired context, not a representative sample of that baseline's typical/tail cases or an unbiased estimate of model advantage. Preserve the fixed display order: median, 95th percentile, maximum mean case MAE, largest remaining mean positive peak.
checkpoint_binding: For each selected case, use its own held-out fire-family protocol and the frozen checkpoint for each declared model/seed. The two seed42 curves and each model's five-seed envelope must come from that same protocol, geometry, target and 61-time grid. Examples from different fire families may use different independently trained checkpoints.
curves: Reference and the actual predictions from seed42 for both primary models. Show each model's pointwise minima/maxima across the five trained seeds as training-variation envelopes; never label them 95% confidence or prediction intervals.
displayed_metrics: Clearly distinguish the case-selection score averaged over seed errors from the MAE of each displayed seed42 trajectory. For the fourth example, also distinguish its five-seed mean positive-peak selection score from the positive peak of each displayed seed42 trajectory; seed42 need not be the worst seed. Show fire family, source batch, crack count, sample ID and constant/restored status.
threshold_markers: Retain both declared thresholds 0.8 and 0.6. For the reference and each displayed seed42 curve, use the first stored time t=60k seconds with response <= threshold, matching engineering_proxy_metrics.event_arrays. A crossing at 3600 seconds is an event only if the stored response reaches the threshold there; otherwise retain right censoring beyond the horizon. Lines may connect stored samples for display, but do not interpolate event times or mark the extrema envelope as though it were a trained trajectory. Preserve all recrossings.
exposure_context: Use the recorded prescribed fire history for the selected case, with temperature and response on separate axes or aligned panels. No claim of verified realized FE amplitude is introduced.
interpretation: Descriptive examples selected by explicit error rules, not new hypothesis tests or proof of full domain coverage. All-family results remain in the fire-transfer figure. Error sign describes the archived index, not a verified structural safety limit.
readability_contract: At a final width of 183 mm, retain at least 8 pt labels and one shared model/seed-envelope legend. Use four case panels with aligned prescribed-temperature strips and response axes rather than a dual-y-axis temperature/response overlay. Keep metadata and the two distinct score types in compact aligned annotations; move extensive hashes and detailed metrics to the source table/caption instead of reducing font size. Each model's band is its own observed pointwise five-seed minimum/maximum; it provides no calibrated simultaneous confidence or prediction coverage for a new case or future training run. All actual reference/prediction/envelope values must remain within the displayed limits.
prohibited_adaptations: Selecting only families with graph gains
Changing checkpoints or smoothing prediction curves
Using mean ensemble predictions as though they were the reported single-model metrics
Replacing a censored event with a horizon event
